description: Erection of front porch, ground floor rear extension, part first floor side and rear extension, alteration of roof
decision_conditions: The proposed development, by virtue of its overall size, scale, bulk and design, would result in disproportionate and unsympathetic additions to the property which would fail to appropriately integrate with the existing dwelling. Considering the scale and depth of the side/rear extension element, combined with the crown roofs and combination of different roof forms, altogether the proposed development would result in an expansion to the property which would appear as visually incongruous and overly-enlarged, failing to integrate successfully with the host dwelling. The proposed additions would be neither subservient nor proportionate to the scale of the existing property, and considered in its entirety the proposal would thereby detract from the character and appearance of the existing dwelling and visual amenities of the area.
